note: Campground and resort on Pickerel Lake Dr at Newaygo, between two lakes: private sand beach with swim dock (9 a.m. to dusk, no lifeguard), boat launch (no pontoons), boat, slip, kayak and golf-cart rentals; cottages, rental campers and a tiny house.
